notes.title: Frog Detective Language Update
notes.notes:
Hello frog fans,

I’m very pleased to announce today that Frog Detective is now available in Japanese! We’ve been working hard with 8-4 to make the translation as true to the original as possible so more people worldwide can solve the mystery too. I’m super proud of the work the team has done and though I can’t speak or read the language myself, I saw all the symbols and thought to myself “I bet that would be funny if I could understand it!”. Luckily for me the game is also available in English which I understand pretty well. Whichever language you choose to play in, I hope you enjoy our silly little series and maybe even figure out whether crime is real!

All the best,
Grace Bruxner

notes.title: VERYCOOL update + SUPERHOT news!
notes.notes:
Hello Frog Friends!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33778951/34b2319487e96cce8940bf41cf194f9ef2f23fa1.gif

I have some exciting news to share! We've just updated the game with some juicy new UI and performance improvements. I have also changed something very important... Let me know if you spot it! Something is significantly different... Hehehehehe...

Anyway, enough of that nonsense. The exciting thing I've been wanting to tell you is that we've signed with the company SUPERHOT!!! They make the game called, well, SUPERHOT! They've just started offering funding and support for tiny indies like me, and Frog Detective was the first game to be signed to their new label, how cool is that??

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33778951/c504378e4a90ea73f5f3b23dd9551a594e5bf52c.png

Tom and I have been holding onto this news for months now and we're so excited to finally share it with you. This means we have money to make more Frog Detective games and focus on them full time! The Haunted Island was made while I was juggling university and working part-time at the wonderful studio League of Geeks. In April, I left to focus on Frog Detective, and formed a studio called WORM CLUB!! That's when SUPERHOT approached us and asked if we would be interested in working with them. 

So what does this mean for the games? Are there guns in Frog Detective now?!

Nope! SUPERHOT is simply giving us funding and advice and helping us with any connections we need to do exciting things with the series. They've been so generous with their time so far, and I am so, so grateful for it. The games will still be silly and weird like the first one, but since we have more time to dedicate to making them, we'll have time to make them as perfectly as we want to. We're not dealing with any publisher-imposed deadlines or creative overhauls-- we're doing exactly what we did before, but this time we can order food delivery and worry less about our bank accounts! I hope this clears up any questions you may have, but if you're confused or want to know more, please ask in the comments of this post or in the forums! Tom and I are here to answer any questions.

Lots of love,
Grace Bruxner xoxoxox
